_note: Fork of exp521 (K=4 sparse-scatter LUT unembedder). Architecture simplification: REMOVE the dual stream and the residual_lut entirely -> a single E=64 residual stream (standard transformer skip: x += out_e per block). The FINAL E-stream vector is passed directly through the sparse unembedder (no separate accumulator). Aux/identity loss back ON at coeff 0.25 (exp518 showed it helps mid-run descent; 0.25 to keep it from dominating the shared embedder as at 1.0). Drops ~3.1M residual_lut params. vs exp518 ~2.12 (dual stream), exp428 Linear head 1.498.
description: Tied unembedder, simplified per user idea: use the PROVEN sparse-scatter TinyMHLut (the exp100/body mechanism) to map E->VOCAB, plus an identity/inverse regularizer (token embeddings unembed to themselves). Drops the brittle parts of exp514-516 (custom row=token head, fixed-random hash, assignment STE, high-LR embedder contortion). Unembedder = TinyMHLut(input_dim=E=64, n_heads=1, n_outputs=unemb_n_sparse=8, n_anchor_pairs=8, tph=4096, sparse_scatter_n_outputs=V) with backward_mode=ste (soft costs 57GB on E->V; ste 6.6GB and is the validated sparse-scatter combo) -> 8.4M params (< the 12.58M Linear head), every token covered by ~1 table. Dual stream collapsed to E (predicted embedding in R^E). Losses: MAIN=CE(unemb(pred_emb),next); AUX=CE(unemb(emb_table_subsample),ids) (identity reg). No assignment STE -- the LUT's own ste backward gives gradients. Standard LRs/warmup (unemb & tok_emb 1e-3) since the learnable LUT adapts to the embedder instead of forcing it onto a fixed hash. vs exp428 Linear head 1.498.
